QUOTE: The default config turns off every threading option: | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` | off (commented out) | ... | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` | off (commented out)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD are commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so the default build defines neither.
